entities.summary: Yehiel Moshe "Hili" Tropper is an Israeli educator, social worker and politician. He is currently a member of the Knesset for National Unity and served as a minister without portfolio in the thirty-seventh government from 2023 to 2024. Tropper previously served as Minister of Culture and Sports from 2020 to 2022.
